   ```bash
   git -C <main-checkout> status --short
   git -C <main-checkout> pull --ff-only
   ```

   ```bash
   git -C <main-checkout> worktree remove <main-checkout>/.claude/worktrees/mobile-nav
   ```

   ```bash
   git -C <main-checkout> branch -d worktree-mobile-nav
   ```

6. **Delete the remote branch.** No force flag.

   ```bash
   git -C <main-checkout> push origin --delete worktree-mobile-nav
   ```
